WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), counts_with_average AS (
  SELECT rating, copy_count, AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS across_rating_average
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(copy_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(copy_count - across_rating_average) AS average_excess
FROM counts_with_average
WHERE copy_count > across_rating_average;
